For the fiscal year ended February 2026, operating revenue was ¥49,731 million (up 5.5% year on year) and segment profit was ¥3,359 million (up 5.5%). The securities report states that operating revenue increased because the year began with freight rates at a high level due to the rise in ocean freight rates from around summer of the previous fiscal year, and because the number of customs clearance orders increased to 152,656 (up 9.6% year on year) and the number of containers handled in ocean freight transport increased to 256,851 TEU in total for exports and imports (up 3.2%).
